Blazers guard Shaedon Sharpe suffered a torn right meniscus in an individual offseason workout and is expected to undergo surgery this week, per a league source. A timeline for his rehab/return is TBD based on surgery. 
ESPN first reported the injury.

items.title: Man, just a brutal beat for Shaedon Sharpe. That's returning post All-Star and Trade Deadline. Maybe he can help in a postseason push.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Man, just a brutal beat for Shaedon Sharpe. That's returning post All-Star and Trade Deadline. Maybe he can help in a postseason push.

The silver lining for Portland? They still have a ton of guard depth: Lillard, Morant, Holiday and Henderson. Plus, Avdija has the ball a lot.
